item.title: The Moscow Times: Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Latvia and Czech Republic to Boycott Russia at 2027 Ice Hockey World Championship
item.description: The CAS decision has also prompted several corporate sponsors to threaten to pull their support from future events.

item.title: The Moscow Times: American Billionaire Leads Swap Plan to Buy Lukoil's Overseas Assets, Sources Say
Meduza: Ukraine names Iuliia Mendel, Zelensky’s former press secretary, as a treason suspect
item.description: Ukraine’s Prosecutor General’s Office said Iuliia Mendel, a former press secretary to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, is suspected of treason and justifying Russia’s armed aggression against Ukraine.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Poland Accuses Russia of ‘Flashlight’ Provocation Along Kaliningrad Border
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Polish and NATO intelligence services received information in recent weeks about possible “acts of diversion or more serious provocations” that could occur near Poland’s border with Russia sometime in early November.

item.title: Meduza: Crowd gathers outside house near Kyiv where mobilized troops and AWOL soldiers were being held. Clashes erupt, shots are fired, and Zelensky’s chief of staff intervenes.
item.description: Several dozen people gathered November 2 outside a private home in the village of Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, near Kyiv, after social media posts earlier that day claimed armed people were holding about 40 people in the house’s basement.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Melania Trump to Host Russian and Ukrainian Delegations at White House
item.description: The U.S. first lady is expected to deliver remarks on the recent ceasefire in the Ukrainian town of Oleshky on Thursday.

item.title: Meduza: White House says Melania Trump will meet with representatives of Russia and Ukraine in Washington
item.description: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump plans to host a meeting between Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House, the White House said in a statement.

item.title: Meduza: Zelensky confirms Ukrainian hackers breached Russia’s emergency alert app in retaliation for earlier attack on Ukraine’s warning system
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Ukrainian hackers carried out a cyberattack on a mobile app Russia’s Emergency Situations Ministry uses to send alerts about threats.

item.title: The Moscow Times: ‘Soft Power in a Cardboard Box’: Pro-Kremlin Activist Calls for Pizza Ban
item.description: Vitaly Borodin urged Russian schools and universities to remove pizza from their cafeteria menus due to Italy’s support for Ukraine.

item.title: Meduza: Russia bombs humanitarian aid distribution site in southern Ukraine, killing 31. More than 40 people remain missing.
item.description: The Russian military carried out two airstrikes with bombs on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region yesterday, killing 31 people, according to the latest official figures.

item.title: Meduza: A Just Russia barely made it into the State Duma, and its longtime leader has vanished from public view. Is the Kremlin ready to pull the plug on the struggling party?
item.description: Sergey Mironov, the 73-year-old leader of A Just Russia, “was unable to maintain a coherent train of thought during his few public appearances and responses to pre-prepared questions, jumping from one idea to another and losing the original meaning of his remarks,” during a trip to Altai Krai in late August, according to the news outlet Sibexpress.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Russia, China and U.S. Summit Under Discussion, Kremlin Says
item.description: Moscow is hoping that plans for a meeting between Putin, Trump and Xi in China will be finalized in the coming days.

item.title: Meduza: Shares in Russian social media giant VK soar more than 45% in just a few days
item.description: Shares in the Russian media holding company VK have risen more than 45% since October 29, Forbes Russia reported. The stock gained 25% on November 2 alone, forcing the Moscow Exchange to activate a special trading mode triggered when an asset’s price moves 20% or more within 10 minutes.

item.title: Meduza: OpenAI hires Dan Driscoll, former US Army secretary who took part in Ukraine peace talks
item.description: OpenAI, the developer of the ChatGPT chatbot, has appointed former U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as “senior counselor for national security modernization,” the company said on its website.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Ukrainian Drones Hit Yaroslavl Oil Refinery, Trigger Power Outages in Crimea
item.description: Officials said two refinery workers were wounded in the attack, but did not provide details about the extent of the damage to the facility.

item.title: The Moscow Times: At Least 31 Killed in Russian Bomb Attack in Zaporizhzhia
item.description: Ukrainian officials said Russia bombed a school being used as an aid distribution point in a village in the village of Komyshuvakha.

item.title: The Moscow Times: U.S.-Mediated Ukraine Peace Talks to Resume in Abu Dhabi Next Week
item.description: White House officials said the U.S. will “mediate working-level negotiations” on Nov. 10 and 11 to advance “Trump's mission to end the war.”

item.title: Meduza: Russia to ban two people from riding a single e-scooter and prohibit delivery couriers from using sidewalks
item.description: Russia’s Transport Ministry has finished drafting a sweeping package of amendments to the traffic code that would, among other things, regulate personal mobility devices, including electric scooters, electric bicycles, and pit bikes.

item.title: The Moscow Times: Western Pharma Giants Paid Millions to Russian Distributors Linked to Fraud, Whistleblower Report Says
item.description: The payments by Merck, Eli Lilly, Novartis and AstraZeneca allegedly helped fund a corruption scheme that kept drug prices high and limited competition across Russia’s public healthcare system.
